description: Official-looking accounts in Arabic script and Greek/Coptic numerals. Probably an account of state properties (amlāk). Contains an ʿalāma "Allāh Ḥawlī". The accounts are organized with months of the hijrī calendar followed by sums of money. Needs examination.
description_he: פנקסים בעלי מראה רשמי בכתב ערבי ובספרות יווניות/קופטיות. דרוש בדיקה.
